No masterclass

No moment to say yes

After a post, people can grab a free chapter or book a discovery call. There’s nothing in between for someone who wants more of you but isn’t ready for 1:1.

Reach

Most followers never see a post

Your last 7 reels got 1,866 to 30.1k views, on an audience of 145k. Posting more won’t change who sees what.

No direct sale

Readers buy from shops, not you

Energize sells through bookshops, so most readers never land on your list and never get a clear next step towards coaching.

No filter

Your calendar does the sorting

Anyone can book a discovery call. With nothing to warm people up or qualify them first, your time goes on finding out who’s ready.

Every high achiever who isn’t ready for 1:1 today leaves with nothing to say yes to, and no clear way back to you.

A free live masterclass between your content and 1:1 coaching

Energize is already your low-ticket product, so the class stays free. It brings in the people who connect with your content, sells a [£37] toolkit on the thank-you page, and shows you who is ready for a discovery call.

Fixes the missing first step

A free class is an easy yes for your followers and newsletter readers, and every sign-up is an email you own, not a sale that sits with a bookshop.

Fixes the missing filter

People who show up live, stay to the end and apply on the replay page tell you they’re ready. The application sorts them before they reach your calendar.

Makes ads pay for themselves

Toolkit sales from the thank-you page cover the ad spend, so reaching new people stops depending on how each reel performs.

95%*

Not ready for 1:1 yet

They join the free class, get the first chapter of Energize, and many pick up the Energy Audit Toolkit [£37]. They stay close through Shots of Energy. You get paid to start the relationship instead of losing them after one reel.

5%

Ready for deep transformation

They show up live, stay to the end and apply for a discovery call on the replay page. The application filters them before your calendar, and the pre-call emails prepare them for 1:1 coaching.
